newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Caradon target raised at BZW.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Caradon target raised at BZW.

text.p: BZW raised its share price target for building materials group Caradon Plc and repeated a "buy" recommendation on the stock, market sources said on Wednesday.
Caradon shares were up 2p at 258 by 1332 GMT.
BZW raised its price target for Caradon to 300p, after the shares rose close to its previous target of 260p, sources said.
They said the move reflected hopes for a more buoyant housing market through 1997, adding that expected cost savings could lead to analysts raising profit estimates.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment.
